about_the_game:
Hop into DELUXE Infinite wall jumping action now! The classic Kick Bot is back with all new visuals, new hazards and terrain to jump through, character customization, online leaderboard, minigames, and more!

An overhaul of the Kick Bot with all new graphics and new features! Maneuver through a procedurally-generated terrain of obstacles like spikes and laser beams. One wrong move and you're a heap of metal. This time with character customization - earn parts and upgrades to make your bot truly unique and compete with friends via the leaderboard. (Also contains the original game for some old school rage!)

50% of the proceeds from this game will go to Gilda's Club of Kentuckiana, the amazing cancer support group that benefited my best friend Eric Lathrop immensely in his final years with us. Eric made this game with me and wrote the majority of the code. Eric was an amazingly funny, kind, unique, opinionated, and talented person and my mentor in programming and I will miss him until the end of time - Alex (AKA fufroom)
